turnaround_reason: FOXF was crushed from its 2022 peak (~$100+) as the post-COVID powersports demand boom reversed, leaving the company with an over-acquisitioned portfolio and compressed margins. Management is executing a two-phase Profit Optimization Plan (~$90M combined savings by end-2026) while divesting non-core assets (Phoenix AAG sold, proceeds to debt reduction), and Q1 2026 showed revenue resuming modest growth (+3.9%) with adj EPS beating by 119%.
bullish_points: Q1 2026 adj EPS of $0.18 beat $0.08 estimate by 119% — two consecutive big beats (Q4 also beat 33%)
Phase 1 ($50M) + Phase 2 ($40M) cost savings plan on track; FY2026 adj EBITDA guidance $174M-$203M implies ~200bps margin expansion
Revenue returning to growth (+3.9% Q1) after deep contraction; FY2026 guide $1.33B-$1.42B
Forward PE of 10.3x is cheap for a branded premium-auto-parts business with $1.48B revenue
Stock at 34% of 200-week MA — deeply washed out; ~10% short interest could amplify any upside move
Q2 2026 earnings August 6 is a near-term catalyst (3 weeks) with a beatable consensus bar
Positive FCF ($47M TTM) despite massive restructuring charges; liquidity not an immediate crisis
bearish_points: Gross margin declining 200bps YoY to 28.9% — restructuring is cutting costs but not yet restoring unit economics
Debt load ($787M) nearly equals market cap ($752M); D/E of 119x is extremely high
BofA downgraded on margin concerns post-Q1 — even a beat drove the stock down 4% on release day
Reported $544.6M net loss (goodwill impairments from acquisition hangover) — balance sheet now impaired
Powersports/premium auto-parts end markets remain soft; consumer discretionary spending at risk
Options illiquid (only 4 expiries, 165 total call OI) — limited leveraged upside vehicles
Short ratio of 4.88 (4.9 days to cover) — not a squeeze setup, just moderate bearish positioning
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings report — if margin trajectory inflects upward alongside continued revenue growth, re-rating from 10x to 13-15x forward is plausible
catalyst_timing: Q2 2026 earnings August 6, 2026 (after market close, ~3 weeks)
suggested_trade: Spot position only — options too illiquid. Size small given debt overhang. Entry at current $17.90-$18.50 range. Consider adding on Q2 beat confirmation.
key_risk: Gross margin fails to recover as cost cuts are offset by volume/mix headwinds — Phase 2 savings take longer to materialize and debt refinancing becomes a distraction
would_skip_if: Q2 earnings show gross margin declining further or management lowers FY2026 EBITDA guidance; or if broader powersports/auto-parts channel data deteriorates materially before August 6
